description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'mlp_shallow' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer + shallow MLP (64 hidden units).
model: mlp_shallow (TF-IDF word featurizer + shallow MLP (64 hidden units))
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'mlp_shallow', group(s): neural); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
